name: Dos Hermanas (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Dos Hermanas (two female figures on white and red).
history: The flag of Dos Hermanas is rectangular, in the proportion 11 by 18, of Spanish-flag red; it is inspired by the banner that King Ferdinand III deposited in these lands, which is preserved in the church of Santa María Magdalena. There are doubts about the origin of that banner, which may have been taken from the Moors or based on the royal banner of León, of similar colours.
